description: This file defines the Theme class within the Opencart Catalog Model namespace. It provides a method to retrieve theme information from the database based on a route parameter.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Model class that interacts with the theme database table to retrieve theme records based on route.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves theme information from the database where store_id matches configuration, route matches input, and status is active.
